name: signal-desk
description: Autonomous, read-only market-research signal desk built on Claude Code (gated autonomy).

scripts.halt: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('HALT', new Date().toISOString())" && echo 'HALT engaged — all agents stopped.'
scripts.resume: node -e "try{require('fs').unlinkSync('HALT')}catch{}" && echo 'HALT cleared — agents may run.'
